subject: Bounded Cosign Pack signing CLI

results.apiReports: Contracts 9 entry points; Core 6 entry points
results.actualCosignRoundTrip: skipped without explicit ABH_TEST_COSIGN; failure, binding and cancellation paths passed

evidence: Core regression rejects wrong Pack identity, digest drift, invalid keys and pre-cancelled calls before external execution
A stalled signer is killed by the bounded deadline; actual signing/verification remains gated behind explicit ABH_TEST_COSIGN
CLI regression covers strict flags, missing key reference, invalid key material, contract-valid failure, output absence and secret non-disclosure
limits: Signing creates signature evidence only; it does not verify provenance or CTK or admit installation
Signer allowlists, revocation, deployment policy and runtime authority remain independent governance decisions
